title: Colorful Neon Maze
description: Colorful Neon Maze is a classic random maze game with 3 difficulty modes designed for everyone! Just control the cube and change the colors of your maze to find the way out and escape the maze. Minimal 2D graphics will allow you to feel like a classic and retro maze game, while neon and a variety of colors will add interest and freshness.
instructions: Use the arrow keys to control the cube and click the mouse for the interface
